title: No chain module in the player
text: The released player is the network alone. On the chain exam rl-v1's champion picks the coin-best action 91.6% of the time, but with a turn planner (value judge or coins judge, K=32) or a chain rule choosing its actions it scored 48.8%, 48.5%, 48.2% (engine kingdoms) and 49.9% head to head against itself without it.
rejected: A statistical turn planner at play time (no gain, 20x slower); a hand-written chain rule (changed 15 of 6,335 decisions).
